messages:
Sam K: External vulnerability assessment scheduled for 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC. Need confirmation on access window and evidence handoff (RBAC changes, KMS access, audit log exports). Who can gate this?
Maria A: I can coordinate intake. What exact access do they need — read-only logs + scoped key usage, or anything broader?
Jon P: Prefer least privilege. Ephemeral assessor role that can list/read logs and pull encrypted artifacts. No full org admin. KMS access should be scoped to an evidence wrapping key only.
Elaine: Agreed. I propose a 4-hour window: 09:00-13:00 UTC. I'll pre-create a timeboxed assessor role and enable CloudTrail snapshot/export.
SecurityBot: Automated: run /create-assessor-request assessor-window=4h approver=@Maria A — please ack to create ephemeral creds.
Maria A: Ack. Policy snippet for the assessor role (example):
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket","cloudtrail:LookupEvents","kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-audit/*","arn:aws:kms:*:123456:key/evidence-proxy"]
}
```
Jon P: For KMS, we'll use a proxy key: only Encrypt/Decrypt for the evidence bucket and no access to production customer keys. Can engineering produce a key-usage log export?
Elaine: Yes. CloudTrail data under s3://redwood-audit/cloudtrail/ — I'll create a dated manifest and an object-lock snapshot for the bundle. Also will capture IAM role binding snapshot (terraform state + live iam get-role calls).
Sam K: We'll need RBAC change records for staging and prod (whitelist the assessor principal in RoleTrust for the window) plus a post-handoff rollback plan.
Maria A: Remediation tracker: create GH issues for each finding with severity/owner/ETA. Request retest slots: 2026-04-09 and 2026-04-16 (morning UTC). Which oncall should be present for 4/2?
Jon P: Require remediation to include audit assertions and regression checks. Evals team to validate outputs before retest.
Elaine: Oncall rotation note: @ops-oncall for 2026-04-02 is Maya D — tagging her here for presence during the window.
ops-oncall: Maya D: I'll be oncall and can respond to incidents. Please DM me the presigned evidence URL when ready.
SecurityBot: Evidence checklist: logs export (CloudTrail + app-audit), IAM bindings snapshot, KMS key policy diff, deployment manifests, config file hashes, and a short runbook describing rollout/rollback steps. Upload to presigned s3 URL and add sha256 checksum.
Maria A: I'll assemble the evidence bundle and post the presigned URL in this thread once it's ready. Will also attach the GH remediation tracker link. :+1:
Sam K: Thanks all — once Maria posts the bundle we'll do a final dry-run access test (ephemeral creds -> list + get) 30m before 09:00 UTC.
Maria A: Plan noted, I'll schedule the dry-run for 08:30 UTC on 2026-04-02.
Elaine: I'll enable extra audit sampling during the window and add a trace tag to relevant requests so they show up in trace logs.
Jon P: One more ask — please export any KMS CloudWatch key usage metrics for the 24h window around the test to help the assessor prove non-customer-key usage.
Maria A: Will include that in the bundle.
SecurityBot: Reminder: create a post-engagement evidence retention policy entry (30 days locked) and then schedule archival.
Maria A: Uploaded GH tracker draft and will update here with presigned URL and final IAM policy when done.
